run.label: frames, and talk that has nothing to do with fire

turns.text: The kids are at school, so it is quiet today.
We painted the shed last spring.

findings.instruction: Move that stack to a spot 30 feet from the walls, or cover it fully with sheet metal.
findings.reason: The frames show an uncovered stack of cut logs leaning against the house wall.

findings.instruction: Replace the 5 feet of fence touching the house with metal, brick or another material that will not burn.
findings.reason: One frame shows a wooden fence section standing right beside the house wall.

findings.instruction: Pick up the dead branches by the wall and haul them to the green waste bin.
findings.reason: Frames show tangled dead branches lying on the ground beside the house.
